description: Remote Holley EFI tuning for LS-swapped Genesis Coupes.
Online course by tuner Joe Simpson that teaches Holley EFI tuning (Terminator X, HP/Dominator and Sniper) through 150+ video lessons: setup, fuel, timing, idle, boost and advanced tables.
redeem: A great place to learn the tuning concepts behind your Holley before you start changing tables.
